case_name: Argha Chatterjee vs State Bank Of India & Anr
facts_of_case: The instant appeal is directed against the order dated 29 October 2024, pursuant to which the application referable to Order IX Rule 13 read with Section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 has come to be rejected by the Trial Judge.

legal_principles.principle: The fact of pendency of a civil suit against a defendant is well within the knowledge of the defendant since service.
legal_principles.held: Since this court has come to the conclusion that there was no infirmity in the services of the summons to defendant no.1 through email and Whatsapp on dated 25.11.2020.

legal_principles.principle: The authenticity of a digitally signed order can be re-verified from the court's portal.
legal_principles.held: This is a digitally signed order. The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
